name: nps_authenticate_subscriber
description: Authenticates a subscriber using their PRAN and OTP to return a session_token. Prerequisites: Subscriber must be registered with NPS and have a valid mobile number for OTP. MUST be called before ALL other tools. NPS has NO public tools — every action requires authentication. What it does NOT do: Does not fetch balance or other details, only provides authentication token.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP sent to the subscriber's registered mobile number.

name: nps_get_account_balance
description: Fetches the current account balance for a specific NPS account tier. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. What it does NOT do: Does not show detailed transaction history or scheme allocation percentages.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

account_type.description: The type of NPS account to check balance for.

name: nps_get_transaction_history
description: Retrieves the transaction history and statement for a given period. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. What it does NOT do: Does not allow modifying or deleting any transactions.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

start_date.description: Start date for transaction history in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date for transaction history in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: nps_get_scheme_details
description: Fetches the current investment scheme allocation and asset class distribution. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. MUST be called before nps_change_scheme_preference. Subscriber must know current allocation before switching. What it does NOT do: Does not change the scheme preferences.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

asset_class.description: Optional asset class filter. E=equity (max 75%), C=corporate bonds, G=govt securities, A=alternative assets (max 5%)

name: nps_change_scheme_preference
description: Updates the asset allocation and pension fund manager preferences. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first, AND MUST call nps_get_scheme_details before this tool. What it does NOT do: Does not allow exceeding maximum regulatory limits for asset classes.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

account_type.description: The type of NPS account to modify.

asset_class.description: The asset class to allocate funds to. E=equity (max 75%), C=corporate bonds, G=govt securities, A=alternative assets (max 5%)

allocation_percentage.description: The percentage to allocate to the selected asset class.

name: nps_make_contribution
description: Initiates a voluntary contribution to the specified NPS account. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. What it does NOT do: Does not process employer (mandatory) contributions.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

name: nps_check_partial_withdrawal_eligibility
description: Evaluates if a subscriber is eligible for partial withdrawal. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. MUST be called before nps_raise_partial_withdrawal. Three simultaneous PFRDA-enforced conditions must ALL pass: (a) subscriber must have completed at least 3 full financial years in NPS (b) withdrawal reason must be one of 6 approved categories (c) amount must not exceed 25% of subscriber's own contributions (not total corpus). Skipping this causes automatic rejection on the real system. What it does NOT do: Does not initiate the actual withdrawal.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

withdrawal_reason.description: The specific reason for the partial withdrawal.

amount.description: The requested partial withdrawal amount in INR.

name: nps_raise_partial_withdrawal
description: Submits a request for partial withdrawal from the NPS Tier I account. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first, AND MUST call nps_check_partial_withdrawal_eligibility first. What it does NOT do: does NOT handle full exit at retirement (age 60+). Full superannuation exit requires offline physical form submission to POP. This tool is ONLY for partial withdrawals during the accumulation phase.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

withdrawal_reason.description: The reason for withdrawal as evaluated in the eligibility check.

amount.description: The approved partial withdrawal amount to claim in INR.

name: nps_track_withdrawal_request
description: Checks the status of a previously submitted withdrawal request. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. MUST be called before nps_raise_grievance when grievance is about a withdrawal — confirm the withdrawal status before escalating. What it does NOT do: Does not cancel or expedite the withdrawal.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

request_id.description: The unique request ID provided when the withdrawal was raised.

name: nps_update_nominee_details
description: Updates or adds a nominee to the NPS account. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. What it does NOT do: Does not change the subscriber's own personal details.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

nominee_name.description: The full name of the new nominee.

nominee_relation.description: The relationship of the nominee with the subscriber.

allocation_share.description: The percentage of the corpus allocated to this nominee.

name: nps_raise_grievance
description: Registers a complaint regarding NPS services. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. MUST call nps_track_withdrawal_request beforehand if the grievance is about a withdrawal. What it does NOT do: Does not resolve the grievance instantly.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

name: nps_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the current status of an existing grievance. Prerequisites: MUST call nps_authenticate_subscriber first. What it does NOT do: Does not provide an option to escalate or modify the existing grievance.

pran.description: 12-digit Permanent Retirement Account Number. Unique to the subscriber for life.

session_token.description: Token returned by nps_authenticate_subscriber. Required for ALL tools except nps_authenticate_subscriber. NPS has no public tools.

grievance_id.description: The unique grievance ticket ID to track.
